```yaml
name: Analyze Reusable

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      os:
        description: 'Operating system to run the job on'
        required: true
        type: string
      build-type:
        description: 'Build configuration (e.g., Release, Debug)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: 'Release'

jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0.x' # Adjust to the SDK version used by the repo

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v1
        with:
          version: '7.4' # Use the latest stable PowerShell

      - name: Install Linux dependencies
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Update package lists
          sudo apt-get update
          # Install dpkg for DEB packaging
          sudo apt-get install -y dpkg
          # If running on Mariner, install azurelinux-repos-extended before dpkg
          if ($env:RUNNER_NAME -match 'mariner') {
            sudo yum install -y azurelinux-repos-extended
            sudo yum install -y dpkg
          }

      - name: Install Windows dependencies
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Install dpkg via Chocolatey (if needed)
          choco install -y dpkg

      - name: Install macOS dependencies
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Install dpkg via Homebrew
          brew install dpkg

      - name: Run unit tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Load build functions
          . .\build.psm1
          # Execute tests (Pester)
          Invoke-Pester -Script .\test -Output Detailed

      - name: Build packages
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Load packaging functions
          . .\tools\packaging\packaging.psm1
          # Build DEB, RPM, and tar.gz packages
          Build-Packages -BuildType ${{ inputs.build-type }}

      - name: Validate packages
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Run package validation tests
          . .\test\packaging\linux\package-validation.tests.ps1
          Invoke-Pester -Script .\test\packaging\linux\package-validation.tests.ps1 -Output Detailed

      - name: Upload built packages
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: packages-${{ runner.os }}
          path: ./artifacts
```
